title: CMT_PMT
summary: A small, minimally documented Jupyter Notebook repository with no README explaining its purpose. A wandb run log's captured requirements.txt lists sdv, ctgan, rdt, copulas, and sdmetrics as installed packages, but no code in the repository actually calls them.
needs: No README or code hits confirm actual use; only a wandb-captured environment snapshot lists SDV-family packages, so purpose and usage cannot be verified.
